merchant/30078.htm.text: Merchant Pano: What can I do for you? Be prepared is my motto -- this world has enough trouble in it without making more for yourself by not paying attention to the basic necessities for survival.

merchant/30078-pk.htm.text: Grocer Pano In a troubled world like this, perhaps it's those who fight with weapons who make the rules. But when peace comes, and it is time to construct a new world, those who only know how to fight will have nothing to do. The world will need people who know the laws. Remember my words well, my …

Q00135_TempleExecutor/30078-01.html.text: Grocer Pano: I'm in real trouble. The deadline is getting closer every day... What to do, what to do? How can I possibly repay the money in time? (Grocer Pano is so distraught that he does not even notice you. Perhaps you should come back later.)

Q00135_TempleExecutor/30078-02.html.text: Grocer Pano: Oh, you are the adventurer from the association. Thank the goddess! Listen, I'm in a real fix. My business has struggled lately, so I borrowed some money from some people I shouldn't have. Now they've raised the interest so much that I can't afford to pay them back! I begged them to ha…

Q00135_TempleExecutor/30078-03.html.text: Grocer Pano: If you bring me 10 Hate Crystals that I can use to pay off my debt, I'll write you a letter of recommendation. Hunt the Delu Lizardman Suppliers, Special Agents, Commanders, Shaman and Cursed Seers to obtain the Crystals.

Q00135_TempleExecutor/30078-04.html.text: Grocer Pano: Oh, you've brought all 10 Hate Crystals. Wonderful! Thank you so very much! Now I can finally free myself of this crushing debt. Here is the letter I promised you. I only hope it will help you as much as you've just helped me!

Q00135_TempleExecutor/30078-05.html.text: Grocer Pano: Thank you for your help! I hope the letter I gave you will help you in turn.

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30847-54.html.text: Head Blacksmith Ferris: Being a level 1 member I can only trade with other level 1 members... Don't be discouraged. You need only find a member of your own level to trade with.
